patterns.name: Local clause heading not promoted to section anchor
patterns.symptom: A parent section accumulates many requirement rows whose first token is a local clause code, but the same code is missing as a section anchor.
source_trigger_features: requirement text starts with local clause code
same clause code absent from section tree
parent section requirement count drifts upward
patterns.current_misread: Preview keeps local clauses under the stale parent section instead of promoting them to canonical section anchors.
patterns.expected_structure_summary: Preserve the local clause code as a section anchor and keep requirement rows bound under that promoted section.
patterns.validated_fix_strategy: Adjust local clause heading preservation and section promotion without sample-specific branching.

patterns.name: Raw scoped code namespace collision
patterns.symptom: Outline emits the same appendix scope plus section code multiple times before instance-aware disambiguation.
source_trigger_features: structural gate still reports duplicate section code
patterns.current_misread: Namespace reuse at outline level is too ambiguous for benchmark gating and review artifacts.
patterns.expected_structure_summary: Either reduce raw duplicate outline generation or make intentional duplicates explicit and benchmark-safe before gating.
patterns.validated_fix_strategy: Tighten appendix scope / section instance generation or update gate semantics only after benchmark review.

patterns.name: Complex table rewrite drifts clause binding
patterns.symptom: Table-heavy pages inflate requirement counts or move expected snippets away from the intended section anchor.
patterns.current_misread: Complex-table rewrite preserves text but loses stable clause binding or dedupe ordering.
patterns.expected_structure_summary: Rewrite table-heavy content without breaking clause ownership, instance keys, or dedupe order.
patterns.validated_fix_strategy: Adjust complex-table rewrite and requirement context binding in generic logic only.
